##### Project general facts

Red Sunset is a collection of luxury villas by Breig Property, each designed as a spacious home for a large family or a group of friends. The villas are organised as two separate buildings around a shared courtyard, with four bedrooms that give every guest their own private space.

Social life revolves around a spacious living room with a fully equipped kitchen and a dining area that opens onto the pool terrace. The highlight of each villa is an exclusive rooftop area set up for barbecue gatherings and for watching the sunset over the ocean.

Interiors blend natural materials with chic industrial finishes, and every bedroom comes with its own bathroom. The villas are delivered fully furnished, including decor and plants, so they are ready to welcome owners or guests straight away.

##### Location description and benefits

Berawa is a relaxed neighbourhood on the edge of Canggu on the southwest coast of Bali, within walking distance of the ocean. Its beach draws surfers and sunset lovers alike, and the area has a trendy character with plenty of boutique shops offering local crafts.

The neighbourhood is known for a diverse culinary scene with cafes, restaurants and eateries serving dishes from around the world. Wellness centres, yoga studios and spas sit alongside beach bars and live music venues, so residents have everything for a comfortable and fulfilling life close by.

Berawa attracts families, couples and solo travellers looking for a base near the ocean, which supports steady demand for villa rentals. Homes in the area work equally well as a private retreat and as an income-generating investment.
